'''[[Chief/Legends|Chief]] Noloinian''' was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] that lived at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Noloinian was spotted flying a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].
